{{Quote|Well, he'd better have those condensing units on the south ridge by midday-- or there'll be hell to pay!|Owen Lars|<ref name="SW1" />}}
'''Condensing units''' were used by [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] like [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]].

==Behind the scenes==
Condensing units were mentioned by Owen Lars in the [[Star Wars (1977) 1|comic adaptation]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars:'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. In the film Owen Lars mentions "units", not "condensing units".
